description: A light, cheap frame with weak joints and a basic work program: carries things and keeps watch.  Low health, few skills.  A sealed activation contract: use it where there is room and the android steps out of its crate and becomes yours.

effect.spawn_message: A basic assistant android unfolds from its crate and stands up.

description: A well-rounded civilian frame with a good work program and ordinary health.  A sealed activation contract: use it where there is room and the android steps out of its crate and becomes yours.

effect.spawn_message: A standard assistant android unfolds from its crate and stands up.

description: A strong, slow labor frame built to haul loads and take hits.  A sealed activation contract: use it where there is room and the android steps out of its crate and becomes yours.

effect.spawn_message: A porter android unfolds from its crate and stands up.

description: An armored security frame with fast reflexes and a sidearm.  A sealed activation contract: use it where there is room and the android steps out of its crate and becomes yours.

effect.spawn_message: A bodyguard android unfolds from its crate and stands up.

description: A top-grade frame: very tough, very strong, very fast, armed and trained.  A sealed activation contract: use it where there is room and the android steps out of its crate and becomes yours.

effect.spawn_message: A elite bodyguard android unfolds from its crate and stands up.
